import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from agents import function_tool
DATABASE_PATH = 'bank.db'

@function_tool
def get_account_balance_summary(account_id: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    account_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT balance, available_balance, currency FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', (account_id,)).fetchone()
    if account_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {'error': 'account not found'}
    window_start_timestamp = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=30)).isoformat()
    totals_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN -amount END), 0) FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ? AND posted_at >= ?', (account_id, window_start_timestamp)).fetchone()
    database_connection.execute('UPDATE accounts SET last_summary_requested_at = ? WHERE id = ?', (datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), account_id))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {'account_id': account_id, 'currency': account_row[2], 'balance': account_row[0], 'available_balance': account_row[1], 'deposits_last_30_days': totals_row[0], 'withdrawals_last_30_days': totals_row[1]}
